title.narrative: AIM Georgia and Ukraine: Accountability through Independent Media

description.narrative: The overall objective is well-informed and politically engaged public of all genders & civil society in Ukraine and Georgia to hold duty-bearers to account. The project will contribute to strengthening the independence and resilience of public interest media and the availability of local safety mechanisms to protect media workers of all genders, mitigate the risks they face and address impunity both online and offline. The project will furthermore support the utilisation of technological advances by the media sector in Georgia and Ukraine to strengthen the freedom of expression and public participation of all genders. Moreover, increased focus on digital solution will contribute to the promotion of human rights, enhance people’s engagement, and make democratic institutions stronger and more responsive.
